headline: Adobe brings Premiere video editor to Android
summary: Adobe has released its Premiere video-editing app for Android, free and available immediately, a year after its iOS launch, with layouts tailored for candy bar and foldable phones.

claims.statement: Adobe has released Premiere for Android.

sources.quote: Adobe has released its Premiere editing app for Android

claims.statement: The Android app is free to use and available immediately.

sources.quote: It’s free to use and available today.

claims.statement: Engadget notes the Android release comes a year after Premiere's iOS launch.

sources.quote: a year after its iOS launch

claims.statement: Wired reports the app has unique layouts for candy bar phones and foldable devices.
